verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own docs say it can integrate with external vault providers to retrieve secret values automatically at send time, which is the vault branch of the story. The evidence is a single thin doc line. It names no providers and does not show that secrets stay out of shared or synced files such as Git Sync and collections. Nothing evidences masked or secret-typed environment variables. missing for 10: masked/secret variable support, named vault providers and setup depth, explicit evidence that synced or shared files exclude secret values, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can keep credentials out of shared files with masked secrets or an external vault integration

citations.quote: Insomnia supports integrating with external vault service providers to retrieve secret values automatically when sending requests.
